summary: Recursive tree teardown. Reads the child pointer at this+0x24; if non-null, recurses into the child subtree first, then frees the child node via FreeWrapper_7bcf. On the null-child path the source returns an uninitialized value (decompiler artifact).

local_names.this: tree node whose child pointer is inspected
local_names.result: return register on the null-child path (uninitialized in raw source)

operations.description: v1 = child pointer stored at this+0x24 (this[9]).
If v1 is non-null, descend and free the subtree; otherwise return immediately (leaf or already-empty node).
Recursively call RecursiveTreeFree on the child node at this+0x24 to free its subtree before freeing the child itself.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(v1) to free the child node's memory after its subtree is released.
Return the FreeWrapper_7bcf result on the non-null path.
On the null-child path the raw source returns the uninitialized 'result' register; the decompiled value is not meaningful.
